why: p33's quiet dark pad giving way to a +15 dB drop-in and its floating drumless breakdowns feel cooler and more immersive than p26's bright filter-swept house hook, even though p26's muffled fade-in into the drop hits well.
p28's wistful late-night beat that goes underwater at 1:06 and snaps into a heavy half-time groove pulls you in, while p34's uneasy Phrygian riff grinds on at one level with no breakdown.
p31's dark chords, solo drum break and band crashing back in at 0:27 are exactly the moody arrival this listener loves, whereas p29 is a pretty music-box arpeggio that barely changes.
p27's filtered intro opening into its 0:27 drop and later A-major lift is fun energy, while p34's sinister, relentless riff with no letup falls in the tense zone this listener likes least.
p31's yearning minor progression after the drums-only break has a darker, more immersive pull than p27's tidy game-style Am-F-E loop that cycles for a minute after the drop.
p28's muffled breakdown snapping into the stuttering half-time section gives a real arrival, while p35's drumless string loop swells gently to its 2:12 peak but leans toward pretty study music.
p35's bittersweet drumless swell toward its 2:12 climax is more immersive than p30's cheerful anime-style rush, which stays at one level with no breakdown for over two minutes.
p30's driving band entrance at 0:20 and the late G#-major lift are energetic fun, whereas p34's uneasy flat-II riff runs relentlessly at the same loudness until it fades.
p26's muffled intro opening into a bittersweet dance hook and its drumless breakdown relaunch beat p34's dense, sinister riff that never thins out.
Both are game-style synth rushes, but p27's filter-sweep build into the 0:27 drop and its D-minor breakdown land harder than p32's bright, happy Am-F chiptune loop.
p33's hypnotic wistful groove with its big drop-in and floating breakdowns pulls you in, while p29 is a gentle music-box pattern that is pretty but static.
Both are moody head-nod tracks, but p33's +15 dB drop-in, drumless floating breakdowns and bright final peak edge out p28's otherwise flat loop, even with p28's strong half-time switch at 1:16.
p32's drums landing at 0:38 and its build-drop-breakdown cycle have drive, while p29's soft music-box arpeggio sits in the sweet, pastel zone this listener likes least.
p32 breathes with its drumless break at 1:02 and filtered breakdown at 1:25 and has a slightly bittersweet minor feel, whereas p30 is a cheerful heroic rush with no letup.
p26's muffled fade-in exploding into its wistful dance hook and the drum drop at bar 88 give the physical arrival p35 lacks, since p35's drumless loop only swells gently to its 2:12 peak.
p31's dark minor mood and band crashing in after the solo drum break are more immersive than p26's bright, polished house loop, which runs its hook for about two and a half minutes.
p33's dreamy, wistful sound world and drumless breakdowns pull you in more than p27's energetic arpeggio loop, which repeats the same eight bars for a minute after its drop.
Neither suits this listener, but p34's heavy, dark C-minor climax at 1:31 has more weight than p29's gentle music-box pattern, which barely moves.
p31's dark drums-only break and yearning full-band entrance at 0:27 are exactly this listener's taste, while p30 is a bright, cheerful game rush at one flat level.
p26's filtered intro dropping into a bittersweet club hook and its riser-led relaunch feel more immersive than p32's bleepy two-chord chiptune loop.
p28's wistful late-night groove and its underwater-to-half-time switch are moodier than p32's bright game-level arpeggios circling Am-F.
p33's hypnotic, wistful loop with its big drop-in and drumless float is the cool, immersive mood this listener loves, unlike p30's cheerful anime rush with no breakdown.
p35's dense bittersweet swell building to the 2:12 climax is more immersive than p29's small, pretty music-box loop, which barely changes.
Both are moody beats with real arrivals, but p31's dark drums-only break crashing into the yearning full band hits harder than p28's otherwise level loop with its half-time switch at 1:16.
p27's muffled arpeggio intro opening into a thumping 0:27 drop and its D-minor breakdown give more impact than p35's gentle drumless loop, which risks feeling like study music.
